title: A REAL Cmd-Q asks how to quit (Keep Sessions is the default); the reopen brings back every workspace, pane, tab and terminal, with its scrollback, from the same daemon
why: Lawrence 2026-11-01 on v2.2.12-opt-e2: 'after quitting and reopening, i lose all the workspaces and terminals ... cmd q needs to prompt for what type of quit'. His Cmd-Q showed no dialog and the app's daemon ended. The driver's own relaunch presses Cmd-Q with debug.key in a slot whose window is never key; this journey sends the real key (CuaDriver) to the key window of a whole-host lease (run.py --whole-host).

steps.title: set-up: Home finishes its first load
400 numbered lines, the last on screen
set-up: three more workspaces, a terminal each
what must come back: daemon pid, holder and hosts, workspaces, terminals, panes
a REAL Cmd-Q (window server key to the key window); the dialog's default is pressed; reopen
the same daemon, holder and hosts run; every workspace and terminal is back and live
the scrollback came back whole: rows 1..400 in order, the last one shown
the split came back with its text
the real Cmd-Q asked how to quit: Keep Sessions (default), End Sessions, End Everything, Cancel
